cv2.policy: OpenCV may register frames and perform profile-bound pixel/template matching only inside the opt-in SHADOW producer; it cannot create Canon facts or bypass evidence gates.

faster_whisper.policy: Allowed only as raw ASR base. Bridge semantics, corrections and canonical facts must be produced by school-owned post-processing and evidence rules.

fitz.policy: PyMuPDF is used only to merge, reopen, render and validate PDF artifacts; it must not infer cards, auctions, evidence provenance or canon status.

google.policy: Authentication and Google Drive transport only; must not make bridge-content decisions.

numpy.policy: Array operations for explicitly registered SHADOW image/model backends only; it must not define bridge meaning, evidence status or promotion policy.

onnxruntime.policy: Executes only a hash-bound, independently gated SHADOW reference-card model; its output remains non-canonical and requires separate rank and suit agreement.

pytesseract.policy: Optional auction-cell OCR challenger only; a call is retained solely when it agrees with a separate verified cell-template channel and passes Laws-level validation.

requests.policy: HTTP transport only; must not make bridge-content decisions.

reportlab.policy: PDF presentation only; it must render supplied evidence classes without creating card, auction, reconstruction or canon decisions.
